description: Claude Code usage analytics on Prometheus: cost, token consumption, sessions, active coding time, lines of code, commits, pull requests, tool decisions, cache hit ratio, and leaderboards by user, model, and session. Consumes Anthropic's OpenTelemetry metrics via OTLP. Works with Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, Mimir, and Thanos. Requires Grafana 11+.

panels.description: Percentuale usata della finestra di 5 ore (rate_limits.five_hour della statusline).

panels.description: Tempo al prossimo reset del limite settimanale.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(sum by (project_name, agent_name, model) (increase(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{model=~"$model"}[$__range])), "project_name", "(non assegnato)", "project_name", ""), "agent_name", "(sessione principale)", "agent_name", "")

panels.title: Token modelli locali
panels.description: Token prompt + generati dei modelli locali, misurati dal proxy Ollama (job ollama-proxy). Locale = modelli che corrispondono alla variabile local_models.

panels.title: % token locali
panels.description: Token locali (proxy) / (token locali + token Claude senza cache read). Stima: i token prompt di Ollama includono il contesto rimandato a ogni richiesta.

targets.expr: ((sum(increase(ollama_prompt_tokens_total{model=~"$local_models"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(ollama_completion_tokens_total{model=~"$local_models"}[$__range])) or vector(0))) / (((sum(increase(ollama_prompt_tokens_total{model=~"$local_models"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(ollama_completion_tokens_total{model=~"$local_models"}[$__range])) or vector(0))) + (sum(increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type!="cacheRead"}[$__range])) or vector(0)))

panels.title: Costo riportato dal client (locale)
